title: A Criminal Underworld of Child Abuse, Part 2

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 大家好，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at The New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日通讯《DealBook》负责商业和政策报道。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: Yesterday, my colleagues Michael Keller and Gabriel Dance described the government's failure to crack down on the explosive growth of child sexual abuse imagery online.
sentences.zh: 昨天，我的同事迈克尔·凯勒和加布里埃尔·丹斯描述了政府在打击网络上儿童性虐待影像爆炸式增长方面的失职。

sentences.en: Today, the role of the nation's biggest tech companies and why, despite pleas from victims, those illicit images can still be found online.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们将探讨美国大型科技公司的角色，以及为什么尽管受害者苦苦哀求，这些非法影像仍能在网上找到。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, February 20th.
sentences.zh: 今天是2月20日，星期四。

sentences.en: If it's possible, I don't want it to get too sticky, but for the sound.
sentences.zh: 如果可以的话，我不想让它太粘，主要是为了声音效果。

sentences.en: I can turn it down.
sentences.zh: 我可以把它调小点。

sentences.en: We'll just get warm.
sentences.zh: 我们只会变暖。

sentences.en: It gets too warm.
sentences.zh: 它变得太热了。

sentences.en: Last summer, Gabriel and I got on a plane and flew out to the West Coast to meet in a lawyer's office to speak with the family that she'd been representing.
sentences.zh: 去年夏天，加布里埃尔和我坐飞机去了西海岸，在一位律师的办公室里见到了她所代理的那个家庭。

sentences.en: As Mike said, like, once we started looking into it, there's so many facets.
sentences.zh: 正如迈克所说，一旦我们开始调查，就会发现它涉及的层面非常多。

sentences.en: So we explained to them a little bit about our reporting
sentences.zh: 所以我们向他们简要解释了我们的报道内容，

sentences.en: and why it was so important that we speak with them.
sentences.zh: 以及为什么与他们交谈如此重要。

sentences.en: Yeah, we're here to answer your questions to it as best we can.
sentences.zh: 是的，我们在这里尽我们所能回答你们的问题。

sentences.en: And who is this family?
sentences.zh: 那么这个家庭是谁呢？

sentences.en: All we can say is that this is a mom and a stepdad who live on the West CoaSt.
sentences.zh: 我们只能说，这是一对住在西海岸的母亲和继父。

sentences.en: And that's because they only felt comfortable speaking with us if we could protect their privacy.
sentences.zh: 这是因为只有在我们能保护他们隐私的前提下，他们才愿意与我们交谈。

sentences.en: I mean, we started this not knowing anything about it.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我们开始时对这一切一无所知。

sentences.en: And I might get emotional here, but, you know, as parents, we're trying to figure out what's the best way for our kid to deal with this.
sentences.zh: 我可能会情绪激动，但你知道，作为父母，我们正在努力寻找让孩子处理这件事的最佳方式。

sentences.en: And they started to tell us a story about what happened to their daughter.
sentences.zh: 于是他们开始向我们讲述发生在他们女儿身上的故事。

sentences.en: It was August 21st, 2013.
How's it work?
sentences.zh: 这是怎么回事？

sentences.en: She was shopping with our two middle children.
sentences.zh: 她当时正带着我们的两个中间的孩子去购物。

sentences.en: So one day, six years ago, the mom is out with her kids doing some back-to-school shopping.
sentences.zh: 六年前的一天，这位母亲带着孩子出去买开学用品。

sentences.en: And she gets a call from the police.
sentences.zh: 然后她接到了警方的电话。

sentences.en: And they tell her she has to come in immediately.
sentences.zh: 他们告诉她必须立即过去。

sentences.en: Just an odd call to get a call from a detective saying, you need to come down to the station right now.
sentences.zh: 接到侦探的电话说你需要马上到警局来，这确实很奇怪。

sentences.en: We need to talk to you.
sentences.zh: 我们需要和你谈谈。

sentences.en: We feel your kids are in danger.
sentences.zh: 我们觉得你的孩子有危险。

sentences.en: And I'm like, what?
sentences.zh: 我当时心想，什么？

sentences.en: She called me panicked, going, they want to talk to me.
sentences.zh: 她惊慌失措地给我打电话说，他们想和我谈谈。

sentences.en: I said, go talk to them.
sentences.zh: 我说，去和他们谈谈吧。

sentences.en: We don't have anything.
sentences.zh: 我们又没做什么。

sentences.en: We're not criminals, so.
sentences.zh: 我们不是罪犯，所以。

sentences.en: It was just odd.
sentences.zh: 这真的很奇怪。

sentences.en: So she goes into the sheriff's office.
sentences.zh: 于是她去了警长办公室。

sentences.en: And there's this FBI agent, introduces himself.
sentences.zh: 那里有一位联邦调查局探员，做了自我介绍。

sentences.en: He said, you know, we think your children are in danger
sentences.zh: 他说，你知道，我们认为你的孩子有危险，

sentences.en: from their father, particularly the youngest one.
sentences.zh: 来自他们的父亲，尤其是最小的那个。

sentences.en: And I was just shocked and had no idea what they were talking about.
sentences.zh: 我当时震惊极了，根本不知道他们在说什么。

sentences.en: No idea.
sentences.zh: 完全不知道。

sentences.en: Mind you, my two other kids who I was shopping with were in the room next door playing or doing something.
sentences.zh: 请注意，我当时带着一起购物的另外两个孩子就在隔壁房间玩耍或做别的事情。

sentences.en: I don't know what they do.
sentences.zh: 我不知道他们在做什么。

sentences.en: And he just went on to say that, you know, we're going to start investigating him or we've been investigating him.
sentences.zh: 他接着说，你知道，我们要开始调查他了，或者说我们一直在调查他。

sentences.en: And there'll be an agent at our house Friday to tell us more.
sentences.zh: 周五会有探员到我们家告诉我们更多信息。

sentences.en: And she showed up Friday morning, August 23rd, nine in the morning.
sentences.zh: 她周五早上8月23日九点准时出现了。

sentences.en: Can I talk to you outside?
sentences.zh: 我能和你到外面谈谈吗？

sentences.en: And we talk outside, and she drops this bomb on us.
sentences.zh: 我们在外面谈话，她向我们投下了一枚重磅炸弹。

sentences.en: And what the agent tells her is that her children's biological father had been sexually abusing her youngest child,
sentences.zh: 探员告诉她，她孩子的亲生父亲一直在性虐待她最小的孩子，

sentences.en: starting at the age of four years old and going on for four years.
sentences.zh: 从四岁开始，持续了四年。

sentences.en: And not only that, he had been documenting this abuse with photos and videos
sentences.zh: 不仅如此，他还用照片和视频记录了这种虐待行为，

sentences.en: and had been posting them online.
sentences.zh: 并把它们发布到了网上。

sentences.en: So, I remember that moment.
sentences.zh: 所以，我记得那一刻。

sentences.en: I mean, I think I kind of doubled over or something.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我想我当时整个人都瘫倒了还是怎么的。

sentences.en: I was just shocked.
sentences.zh: 我当时只是震惊。

sentences.en: I said, when did this start?
sentences.zh: 我说，这是什么时候开始的？

sentences.en: How long has this been going on?
sentences.zh: 这持续多久了？

sentences.en: How did I not know a mom?
sentences.zh: 作为一个母亲，我怎么会不知道？

sentences.en: So all of those questions and all those feelings, and I mean, everything just came crashing down.
sentences.zh: 所以所有这些问题和所有这些感受，我的意思是，一切都崩溃了。

sentences.en: What does this couple tell their children at this point?
sentences.zh: 这对夫妇此时该如何告诉他们的孩子？

sentences.en: The FBI agent said, actually, it's better if I'm the one to tell your kids.
sentences.zh: 联邦调查局探员说，其实，最好由我来告诉你的孩子们。

sentences.en: In her experience, it would be best for the news to come from her, as opposed to from me telling the kids directly that their dad was arrested
sentences.zh: 根据她的经验，最好由她来传达这个消息，而不是由我直接告诉孩子们他们的父亲被捕了，

sentences.en: because kids might blame me and point the finger.
sentences.zh: 因为孩子们可能会责怪我，把矛头指向我。

sentences.en: I said, yeah, whatever you think.
sentences.zh: 我说，好吧，随你怎么想。

sentences.en: She passed around her FBI badge and showed the kids and built a rapport with them.
sentences.zh: 她出示了她的联邦调查局徽章，给孩子们看，并与他们建立了融洽的关系。

sentences.en: And then...
sentences.zh: 然后……

sentences.en: She said, you know, your dad has been arrested.
sentences.zh: 她说，你知道，你们的爸爸被捕了。

sentences.en: I don't think we even talked about what it was for or why he was arrested, just that he was arrested and they're still investigating.
sentences.zh: 我想我们甚至没有讨论过是因为什么或者为什么被捕，只是说他被捕了，他们还在调查中。

sentences.en: You know, even to this day, you know, I think about...
sentences.zh: 你知道，即使到了今天，你知道，我还是会想……

sentences.en: Again, I was married to this guy.
sentences.zh: 再说一次，我曾经和这个家伙结婚。

sentences.en: How did I miss that?
sentences.zh: 我怎么会没发现呢？

sentences.en: Still, and this is six years later.
sentences.zh: 即使是现在，这已经是六年之后了。

sentences.en: You know, how did I miss that?
sentences.zh: 你知道，我怎么会没发现呢？

sentences.en: So there's a piece of that guilt that's always going to be there, I think.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为，那种负罪感会一直存在。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: But it isn't.
sentences.zh: 但事实并非如此。

sentences.en: It's your fault.
sentences.zh: 这是你的错。

sentences.en: It's not your fault.
sentences.zh: 这不是你的错。

sentences.en: And how can somebody do that to their old child?
sentences.zh: 一个人怎么能对自己的亲生孩子做出那种事？

sentences.en: I don't think I'll ever understand
sentences.zh: 我想我永远无法理解

sentences.en: a person like that.
sentences.zh: 那样的人。

sentences.en: And she's just now developmentally dealing with the effects of it.
sentences.zh: 她现在才开始从心理发育层面应对这些影响。

sentences.en: She's angry and she's acting out and...
sentences.zh: 她很愤怒，表现得很叛逆，而且……

sentences.en: Her daughter is now a young teenager.
sentences.zh: 她的女儿现在是个年轻的青少年了。

sentences.en: She's in counseling now, you know, so...
sentences.zh: 她现在在接受心理咨询，你知道，所以……

sentences.en: And has a counselor and is not only dealing with all of the normal things that young teenagers have to deal with, but the trauma of being sexually abused at such a young age.
sentences.zh: 她有心理咨询师，不仅要处理年轻青少年必须面对的所有正常问题，还要处理在如此年幼时遭受性虐待的创伤。

sentences.en: So that's something she's just now having to learn how to say no, how to inform others that she's not comfortable with something.
sentences.zh: 所以这是她现在才开始学习如何说不，如何告知他人她对某事感到不舒服。

sentences.en: And she's only 13.
sentences.zh: 她才13岁。

sentences.en: And meanwhile, even though the physical abuse ended six years ago, the images continue to circulate to this day.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，尽管身体上的虐待在六年前就结束了，但这些影像至今仍在流传。

sentences.en: And the parents know that because they get notified whenever someone is arrested having these images in their possession.
sentences.zh: 父母们知道这一点，因为每当有人因持有这些影像而被捕时，他们都会收到通知。

sentences.en: And why would they be notified?
sentences.zh: 为什么要通知他们？

sentences.en: What's the point?
sentences.zh: 有什么意义呢？

sentences.en: It feels like it would just be a horrendous reminder every time that this is still happening.
sentences.zh: 感觉这只会是一个可怕的提醒，每次都在提醒他们这件事还在发生。

sentences.en: One of the abilities that victims of this crime have is to seek restitution from the offenders.
sentences.zh: 这类犯罪的受害者拥有的能力之一是向罪犯寻求赔偿。

sentences.en: So when they're notified, they and their lawyers can petition the court to get a certain sum of money, which is a really good thing.
sentences.zh: 所以当他们收到通知时，他们和他们的律师可以向法院申请获得一笔赔偿金，这确实是一件好事。

sentences.en: And it helps to rectify some of the damage that was done.
sentences.zh: 这有助于弥补所造成的部分伤害。

sentences.en: But Mike, you're right.
sentences.zh: 但是迈克，你是对的。

sentences.en: Oh my gosh, this person in Kansas and New York, somebody in Wisconsin saw my kid and oh my God.
sentences.zh: 天哪，堪萨斯州和纽约的这个人，威斯康星州的某个人看到了我的孩子，天哪。

sentences.en: It is a brutal double-edged sword, these notifications.
sentences.zh: 这些通知是一把残酷的双刃剑。

sentences.en: Oh my God, there's people out there who know about this and they can watch it over and over.
sentences.zh: 天哪，外面有人知道这件事，他们可以一遍又一遍地观看。

sentences.en: And for this young woman,
sentences.zh: 而对于这位年轻女性来说，

sentences.en: her parents and their lawyer
sentences.zh: 她的父母和他们的律师

sentences.en: received more than 350 notices in just the last four years.
sentences.zh: 在过去四年里收到了超过350份通知。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So something on the order of a hundred times a year, somebody is convicted
sentences.zh: 所以大约每年有一百次，有人被判刑，

sentences.en: of having looked at these photos of their daughter.
sentences.zh: 因为观看了这些她女儿的照片。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: What do you think should be kind of in the front of our minds?
sentences.zh: 你认为我们应该首先考虑什么？

sentences.en: What do you think is really important for us to understand?
sentences.zh: 你认为对我们来说真正重要的是理解什么？

sentences.en: The internet technology companies need to really do something about this because, I don't know, it's juSt...
sentences.zh: 互联网科技公司真的需要对此采取行动，因为，我不知道，这简直……

sentences.en: I don't know enough about technology, but I juSt...
sentences.zh: 我对技术了解不多，但我只是……

sentences.en: Where is this crap, you know?
sentences.zh: 这些垃圾到底在哪儿，你知道吗？

sentences.en: Certainly for the stepfather,
sentences.zh: 当然，对于继父来说，

sentences.en: his question, which is a legitimate question,
sentences.zh: 他的问题，一个合理的问题，

sentences.en: is...
How do we get it off?
sentences.zh: 我们该怎么把它删掉？

sentences.en: Why can't they just take it down?
sentences.zh: 为什么他们不能直接把它撤下来？

sentences.en: How do we...
sentences.zh: 我们该怎么……

sentences.en: How do we...
sentences.zh: 我们该怎么……

sentences.en: How do we make it away?
sentences.zh: 我们该怎么让它消失？

sentences.en: And that's the same question we had.
sentences.zh: 这也是我们当时的问题。

sentences.en: Why, six years later, are these images and videos still showing up on some of the largest technology platforms in the world?
sentences.zh: 为什么六年过去了，这些照片和视频仍然出现在世界上一些最大的科技平台上？

sentences.en: Figure it out.
sentences.zh: 想办法解决它。

sentences.en: We've got this technology.
sentences.zh: 我们有这种技术。

sentences.en: We can go to the moon and Mars and stuff.
sentences.zh: 我们可以去月球和火星等等。

sentences.en: We can get this crap off the web.
sentences.zh: 我们可以把这些垃圾从网上清除掉。

sentences.en: And are the companies doing enough to prevent it?
sentences.zh: 公司是否在采取足够的措施来预防它？

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁了？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 每个人都知道你需要订阅《纽约时报》才能访问所有的报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果可以免费试用《纽约时报》一个月，而且无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在应用里的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 用一个月的时间越过付费墙，看看《纽约时报》的订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果您还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《纽约时报》应用程序，获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: Gabriel, Michael, how do you begin to answer these parents very reasonable questions about why these images of their child's sexual abuse keep showing up online?
sentences.zh: 加布里埃尔，迈克尔，你们如何开始回答这些父母非常合理的问题：为什么这些关于他们孩子性虐待的影像不断出现在网上？

sentences.en: So, before we can answer the question of why these images keep showing up,
sentences.zh: 所以，在我们回答为什么这些影像不断出现的问题之前，

sentences.en: we needed to understand where the images were online and what companies were responsible for people sharing them.
sentences.zh: 我们需要了解这些影像在网上的位置，以及哪些公司对人们分享这些影像负有责任。

sentences.en: But the National Center, which you'll remember is the designated clearinghouse for this information,
sentences.zh: 但是国家中心，你还记得它是该信息的指定信息交换中心，

sentences.en: wouldn't tell us.
sentences.zh: 不肯告诉我们。

sentences.en: But they know, right?
sentences.zh: 但他们知道，对吧？

sentences.en: So why wouldn't they tell you?
sentences.zh: 那他们为什么不告诉你呢？

sentences.en: Why wouldn't they give you that information?
sentences.zh: 他们为什么不把这些信息提供给你？

sentences.en: Part of the reason why they don't divulge these numbers is because the companies are not required by law to look for these images.
sentences.zh: 他们不愿透露这些数字的部分原因是，法律并未要求这些公司去搜寻这些图像。

sentences.en: It's voluntary.
sentences.zh: 这是自愿的。

sentences.en: It's voluntary to look for them.
sentences.zh: 搜寻这些图像是自愿行为。

sentences.en: Right.

sentences.en: And so what this family has decided

sentences.en: They're not going to tell her that her images are online.

sentences.en: There's no good it would do.

sentences.en: I don't want her to be fearful of what other people might be seeing of her when they do a Google search for a bullet.

sentences.en: I think that's why we're doing this story, to be honest with you.
sentences.zh: 老实说，我想这就是我们做这篇报道的原因。

sentences.en: What I did tell him was that that was the point of us doing this reporting, was the hopes that something would change and that in five years those images would no longer be there.

sentences.en: But once we publish this article and we see how they respond and we see how not only tech companies but I mean...
